mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement ( trade_seq, member_seller_seq, sale_price, delivery_cost, commission_rate, commission, settlement_amount, settlement_st, request_dtm ) VALUES ( #{trade_seq}, #{member_seller_seq}, #{sale_price}, #{delivery_cost}, #{commission_rate}, #{commission}, #{settlement_amount}, 'REQUESTED', now() )
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, t.sale_title FROM settlement s JOIN sb_trade_info t ON s.trade_seq = t.trade_seq WHERE s.settlement_seq = #{settlement_seq}

SELECT s.*, t.sale_title, seller.member_nicknm AS member_seller_nm FROM settlement s JOIN sb_trade_info t ON s.trade_seq = t.trade_seq LEFT JOIN member_info seller ON s.member_seller_seq = seller.member_seq WHERE s.trade_seq = #{trade_seq}

SELECT s.*, t.sale_title, seller.member_nicknm AS member_seller_nm, mba.bank_code, mba.bank_account_no, mba.account_holder_nm FROM settlement s JOIN sb_trade_info t ON s.trade_seq = t.trade_seq LEFT JOIN member_info seller ON s.member_seller_seq = seller.member_seq LEFT JOIN member_bank_account mba ON s.member_seller_seq = mba.member_seq WHERE s.settlement_st = #{settlement_st} ORDER BY s.request_dtm DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE sb_trade_info SET settlement_st = #{settlement_st}, upd_dtm = now() WHERE trade_seq = #{trade_seq}
UPDATE settlement SET settlement_st = 'COMPLETED', settled_dtm = now() WHERE settlement_seq = #{settlement_seq} AND settlement_st = 'REQUESTED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM settlement WHERE settlement_st = #{settlement_st}
